title: Transient Tertiary Structures of Disordered Dynein Intermediate Chain Regulate its Interactions with Multiple Partners.
authors: Morgan, Jessica L; Yeager, Andrew; Estelle, Aidan B; Gsponer, Jorg; Barbar, Elisar
one_liner_zh: 该文通过NMR与约束分子动力学模拟揭示无序动力蛋白中间链N-IC中瞬态三级结构（SAH与H2螺旋间相互作用）如何调控其与p150(Glued)和NudE等多伙伴的差异化结合，直接聚焦IDP介导的PPI机制建模，方法上结合实验与物理模拟，高度契合本课题。
abstract: The N-terminal domain of dynein intermediate chain (N-IC) is central to the cytoplasmic dynein 'cargo attachment subcomplex' and regulation of motor activity. It is a prototypical intrinsically disordered protein (IDP), serving as a primarily disordered polybivalent molecular scaffold for numerous binding partners, including three dimeric dynein light chains and coiled coil domains of dynein partners dynactin p150(Glued) and NudE. At the very N-terminus, a 40 amino acid single alpha helix (SAH) forms the major binding site for both p150(Glued) and NudE, while a shorter nascent helix (H2) separated from SAH by a disordered linker, is necessary for tight binding to dynactin p150(Glued) but not to NudE. Here we demonstrate that transient tertiary interactions in this highly dynamic protein underlie the differences in its interactions with p150(Glued) and NudE. NMR paramagnetic relaxation enhancement experiments and restrained molecular dynamics simulations identify interactions between the two non-contiguous SAH and H2 helical regions, the extent of which correlates with the length and stability of H2, showing clearly that tertiary and secondary structure formation are coupled in IDPs. These interactions are significantly attenuated when N-IC is bound to NudE, suggesting that NudE binding shifts the conformational ensemble to one that is more extended and with less structure in H2. While the intrinsic disorder and flexibility in N-IC modulate its ability to serve as a binding platform for numerous partners, deviations of this protein from random-coil behavior provide a process for regulating these binding interactions and potentially the dynein motor.
abstract_zh: 动力蛋白中间链的N端结构域（N-IC）在细胞质动力蛋白的“货物附着亚复合体”及运动活性调控中起核心作用。它是一种典型的固有无序蛋白（IDP），作为主要无序的多价分子支架，为众多结合伙伴提供平台，包括三种二聚体动力蛋白轻链以及动力蛋白伙伴dynactin p150(Glued)和NudE的卷曲螺旋结构域。在最N端，一个由40个氨基酸组成的单α螺旋（SAH）形成p150(Glued)和NudE的主要结合位点，而一个较短的初生螺旋（H2）通过无序连接子与SAH分隔，对于与dynactin p150(Glued)的紧密结合是必需的，但对NudE则非必需。在此，我们证明这种高度动态蛋白中的瞬态三级相互作用是其与p150(Glued)和NudE相互作用差异的基础。核磁共振顺磁弛豫增强实验和约束分子动力学模拟识别出两个非连续螺旋区域SAH和H2之间的相互作用，其程度与H2的长度和稳定性相关，清晰表明在IDP中三级和二级结构形成是耦合的。当N-IC与NudE结合时，这些相互作用显著减弱，提示NudE结合将构象集合转变为更伸展且H2结构较少的形态。尽管N-IC中的固有紊乱和灵活性调节其作为众多伙伴结合平台的能力，但该蛋白偏离随机卷曲行为的过程为调控这些结合相互作用及潜在的动力蛋白运动提供了机制。
